source: [reflective] And this... is the Long Road. Every lantern marks a step — a mobile developer internship at PT Siaga Abdi Utama, full-stack contracts... and now, AI engineering at Fanisin. Behind it all, a degree in Computer Science... [warmly] ...and years of leading people — from esports tournaments, to welcoming brand-new students.
